item.raw_source:
import Mathlib

open Function Set

abbrev putnam_2013_b1_solution : ℤ := (-1)
-- -1
/--
For positive integers $n$, let the numbers $c(n)$ be determined by the rules $c(1)=1$, $c(2n)=c(n)$, and $c(2n+1)=(-1)^nc(n)$. Find the value of $\sum_{n=1}^{2013} c(n)c(n+2)$.
-/
theorem putnam_2013_b1
(c : ℕ → ℤ)
(hc1 : c 1 = 1)
(hcodd : ∀ n : ℕ, n > 0 → c (2 * n + 1) = (-1) ^ n * c n)
: (∑ n : Set.Icc 1 2013, c n * c (n.1 + 2)) = putnam_2013_b1_solution :=
sorry

probe.proof:
by
  let c : ℕ → ℤ := fun m =>
    Nat.strongRecOn m (fun k ih =>
      if k = 1 then 1 else
      if h : k > 1 ∧ k % 2 = 1 then
        (-1 : ℤ) ^ ((k - 1) / 2) * ih ((k - 1) / 2) (by omega)
      else 0)
  have hc (m : ℕ) :
      c m = if m = 1 then 1 else
        if h : m > 1 ∧ m % 2 = 1 then
          (-1 : ℤ) ^ ((m - 1) / 2) * c ((m - 1) / 2)
        else 0 := by
    unfold c
    rw [Nat.strongRecOn_eq]
    rfl
  have hc1 : c 1 = 1 := by rw [hc]; simp
  have hc2 : c 2 = 0 := by rw [hc]; norm_num
  have hodd : ∀ n : ℕ, n > 0 → c (2 * n + 1) = (-1 : ℤ) ^ n * c n := by
    intro n hn
    rw [hc]
    have ha : 2 * n + 1 ≠ 1 := by omega
    have hb : 2 * n + 1 > 1 ∧ (2 * n + 1) % 2 = 1 := by omega
    simp only [if_neg ha, dif_pos hb]
    have hdiv : (2 * n + 1 - 1) / 2 = n := by omega
    rw [hdiv]
  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
  intro heq
  have heven := (heq.mp ⟨hc1, hodd⟩).2.2 1 (by omega)
  norm_num [hc1, hc2] at heven
